notes.title: Chinese version of “Sugar,sugar,sugarcoat” will be released
notes.notes:
I am pleased to announce the release of the Chinese version of our game “Sugar,sugar,sugarcoat”.

The publisher, Pujia8 Studio, will be in charge of translation and other promotional activities. I would like to thank Pujia8 Studio for asking us to translate “Sugar,sugar,sugarcoat” into Chinese, and they are still working on it.

I am currently planning to release it in July~September. The Chinese version will not be a stand-alone game, but rather an update that will allow the language to be changed within the game.

I have received requests for this in the past, but due to various reasons, we apologize for the delay in responding to them.

I am very happy to announce this to everyone who has played or wants to play “Sugar,sugar,sugarcoat”.

I will keep you posted on the release of the Chinese version.
